contracts.name: HSI futures
contracts.multiplierNote: HKD 50 per index point on the full contract
contracts.expiryRule: Business day before the last business day of the contract month
contracts.expiryRuleShort: second-to-last business day of the month

contracts.name: MHI futures (Mini-HSI)
contracts.multiplierNote: One fifth of the full HSI contract
contracts.expiryRule: Same as HSI: business day before the last business day of the contract month
contracts.expiryRuleShort: second-to-last business day of the month

contracts.name: Nikkei 225 futures (OSE)
contracts.multiplierNote: JPY 1,000 per index point on the standard contract
contracts.expiryRule: SQ on the second Friday of the contract month

contracts.name: Nikkei 225 futures (SGX)
contracts.multiplierNote: JPY 500 per index point; also listed in USD with a USD multiplier
contracts.expiryRule: SQ on the second Friday of the contract month

contracts.name: TOPIX futures
contracts.multiplierNote: JPY 10,000 per index point (TOPIX index level is roughly a tenth of the Nikkei, so notional is comparable)
contracts.expiryRule: Second Friday (SQ) of the contract month

contracts.name: FTSE China A50 futures
contracts.expiryRule: Last business day of the contract month
contracts.expiryRuleShort: last business day of the month

contracts.name: ASX SPI 200 futures
contracts.expiryRule: Third Thursday of the contract month
